subject: general
question: Who among the following was awarded the 2020 Tyler Prize for Environmental Achievement on 27 January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pavan Sukhdev.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Renowned Indian environmental economist and UN Environment Programme (UNEP) Goodwill Ambassador Pavan Sukhdev__ has won the 2020 Tyler Prize.
 
• It is regarded as the "Nobel Prize for the Environment".
 
• He was awarded for his groundbreaking "green economy" work.
 
• Sukhdev will receive the award alongside conservation biologist Gretchen Daily on 1 May 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **UNEP** is a programme of the United Nations that coordinates the organization's environmental activities and assists developing countries in implementing environmentally sound policies and practices.
 
• UNEP Headquarters:** Nairobi, Kenya**
